notes:
Top-line: Lyra is a regional hospital network (9 hospitals, ~8,000 clinicians) building a HIPAA-safe RAG search for clinical docs (progress notes, imaging reports, discharge summaries).
- Primary ask: scalable embeddings + reranking pipeline for 200M+ clinical records (initial indexed unit ~40M documents, growth plan to 200M within 12 months).
- Latency targets: vector retrieval + reranker p95 <= 300ms; end-to-end RAG (retrieve+rerank+generation) for short clinician answers < 1.2s; background batch/analytics can be slower.
- Cost constraint: aiming for avg cost/query <= $0.08 at projected 50k qps-month volume; high sensitivity to token charges from reranker/generation.
- Model preferences: prefer open-source embeddings (SBERT-style) for cost control; open to Redwood-verified embed/retriever bundles; quantized cross-encoder reranker for latency/cost tradeoffs.
- Security: BAA required; SOC2 + ISO27001 desirable; full immutable audit logs with per-query lineage, KMS integration for key management; strict retention and deletion workflows; SSO/SAML + SCIM; VPC peering/PrivateLink and egress control; optional on-prem isolated EHR connector for PHI flows.
- POC status: ingested 1.2M de-identified notes into prototype index; embeddings recall good on dev prompts; reranker reduced false-positive snippets but increased compute load (CPU/GPU tradeoff). See experiments spreadsheet.
- Timeline: security questionnaire submitted 2024-10-05; legal requested BAA redline 2024-10-18; infra demo (VPC peering) 2024-11-01; cost model review 2024-11-12.
- Quotes: CISO: 'We need provable auditability for every returned snippet'; Head of Clinical AI: 'Clinicians expect sub-second answers in chart view'.
- Integration notes: event-driven ingestion via FHIR streams, optional de-id/redaction stage, patient_id hashed and stored as metadata, RBAC enforced at query layer; want streaming sync and change-capture for real-time docs.
- Technical risks: reranker compute cost at scale; index growth and shard strategy; cold-start latency for large hotspots; metadata filtering correctness for patient-level access control.
- Next steps: run full-scale latency bench on Redwood Dedicated with quantized reranker; validate KMS + audit trail; legal sign BAA redline; engineering to validate VPC peering; finance to confirm pilot budget.
- Blockers: legal BAA signoff, infra budget, performance validation on full-sized index.
